description: This file defines a final class 'StagingExtension' within the Twig templating engine, used as a staging area for registering and managing functions, filters, node visitors, token parsers, and tests. It provides methods for adding and retrieving these components, enabling extension and customization of Twig's behavior.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\StagingExtension
classes.description: A final class that serves as a staging area to register and retrieve Twig extensions such as functions, filters, node visitors, token parsers, and tests.

methods.name: addFunction
methods.description: Registers a new TwigFunction. Throws a LogicException if a function with the same name is already registered.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Registers a new TwigFilter. Throws a LogicException if a filter with the same name is already registered.

methods.name: addNodeVisitor
methods.description: Adds a node visitor to the list.

methods.name: addTokenParser
methods.description: Registers a token parser. Throws a LogicException if a parser with the same tag is already registered.

methods.name: addTest
methods.description: Registers a new TwigTest. Throws a LogicException if a test with the same name is already registered.
